title: Transition on an Embedded Original State
statement: Let $F$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine, let $s$ be one of its states, let $\mathrm{inp}\in\{\mathrm{none},\mathrm{some}(b):b\in\{0,1\}\}$, and let $w$ assign a possibly blank symbol to each of the $k+1$ work tapes of the constructed oracle machine. At the state corresponding to $s$, its transition on $\mathrm{inp}$ and $w$ is the capture transform of $F$'s transition on $\mathrm{inp}$ and the symbols on the first $k$ tapes, using the oracle machine's query state as the return state.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite-state binary Turing machine
$w$ gives an optional Boolean symbol for each of the $k+1$ work tapes
